en: I can talk about the ongoing past: was/were + -ing, with when and while.
I can use the present perfect: ever, never, since, for, already, yet and just.
I can compare: -er and -est, more and most, as … as.
I can talk about the future: going to for a plan, will for a decision made on the spot.
I can express ability, advice and obligation with can, should, must and have to.
